name: ProfileOffer
description: Profiles offered by the client, one octet per profile (handshake only).

name: ProfileSelect
description: Profile selected by the server (handshake only).

name: KEMOffer
description: KEMs offered by the client.

name: KEMSelect
description: KEM selected by the server.

name: SigOffer
description: Signature algorithms offered.

name: SigSelect
description: Signature algorithm selected.

name: KEMShare
description: Public KEM share.

name: KEMCiphertext
description: KEM encapsulation ciphertext.

name: IdentityKey
description: Sender's identity public key (handshake AUTH).

name: CertVerify
description: SignatureScheme (u16) + signature over the transcript (handshake AUTH).

name: Finished
description: Finished MAC, length = negotiated KDF-hash output (handshake AUTH).

name: AEADOffer
description: AEAD suites offered by the client (handshake only).

name: AEADSelect
description: Ordered list of the server-selected AEAD suites, primary first (2 octets per suite; N=1 at Standard, N=2 at High/Sovereign). Handshake only.

name: (reserved)
description: Reserved for a companion specification.

name: OpaqueContentType
description: Full IANA media-type string for opaque carriage, when the payload's media type is not one of the BridgeEnvelope content_type enumerated values (companion specification NPAMP-CC-OPAQUE).

name: (reserved)
description: Reserved for a companion specification.

name: (reserved)
description: Reserved for a companion specification (handshake only).

description: Reserved; path validation uses the PATH_CHALLENGE / PATH_RESPONSE frames (0x0008 / 0x0009), not a TLV.

name: (reserved)
description: Reserved; see 0x15.

name: KeyUpdateMarker
description: Key-update epoch marker.

name: ProtectionMode
description: Reserved; no defined values (header protection provided by the secure transport).

name: RatchetGeneration
description: Master-ratchet generation index (8-octet big-endian), mirroring KeyUpdateMarker 0x17; carried in the MASTER_RATCHET/REKEM control frames (spec/10 section 9).

name: (reserved)
description: Forward-incompatible extension points (Type high bit set).
